title: Canonical Frobenius comparison identifies ordinary cohomology pullbacks
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and the finite coefficient ring $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, with $\ell\ne p$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite and $n\geq1$, of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Let $Y_0$ be proper of finite type over $k_0$, put $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, and fix $m\geq1$. Write $\Phi_Y$ and $g_Y$ for the scheme and geometric Galois Frobenii of [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]. On the small pro-etale site use derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and ordinary cohomology [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology]. Specify $\kappa_{m,Y}:L(\Phi_Y^m)^*\xrightarrow{\sim}L(g_Y^m)^*$ of [prop-trf-scheme-galois-comparison] by the factorization $\Phi_Y^m=g_Y^m\operatorname{Fr}_Y^{(q^m)}$ of [prop-trf-frobenius-factorization], the canonical pullback-composition identification [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition], and the multiplicative absolute-Frobenius trivialization [lem-trf-absolute-frobenius-site]. Let $d_\Phi:L(\Phi_Y^m)^*A_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}A_Y$ and $d_g:L(g_Y^m)^*A_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}A_Y$ be the canonical constant-sheaf identifications. Then $d_g\circ\kappa_{m,Y,A_Y}=d_\Phi$.

For $M\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ and $h=\Phi_Y^m,g_Y^m$, let $\rho_{h,M}:R\Gamma(Y,M)\to R\Gamma(Y,Lh^*M)$ be ordinary cohomology pullback, induced by the pullback/direct-image adjunction unit [def-weil-derived-direct-image] and the canonical identification of global sections of a direct image with global sections on the source. Then
$$
R\Gamma(Y,\kappa_{m,Y,M})\circ\rho_{\Phi_Y^m,M}=\rho_{g_Y^m,M}.
$$
This is an equality of morphisms in $D(A)$, natural in $M$, with the canonical constant section $1$ preserved by the comparison.
